title.zh-CN: 虚构海岸城市旅行海报

description.zh-CN: 以虚构海岸城市为主题制作 2:3 丝网印刷风旅行海报。来源预览；效果及授权待核实。
description.en-US: Create a 2:3 screen-print travel poster for a fictional coastal city. Source preview; output and rights unverified.

zh-CN.prompt: 为名为 SOLA 的虚构海岸城市制作一张原创编辑风格旅行海报。阳光照亮的赤陶色阶梯从白色现代主义住宅之间向下延伸，通往碧蓝的港湾；远处有一艘帆船和一座山丘，并以一位小小的骑行者提供比例参照。采用精致的平面丝网印刷视觉效果，带有轻微的纸张颗粒。配色包括珊瑚红、钴蓝、奶油白和海绿色；构图具有鲜明的几何形态与留白。顶部只放一个小而清晰可读的标题 SOLA。不要标志或真实地名。制作竖版 2:3 海报。

en-US.prompt: An original editorial travel poster for a fictional coastal city named SOLA. A sunlit terracotta stairway descends between white modernist houses toward a turquoise harbor, distant sailboat and hill, one small cyclist for scale. Sophisticated flat screen-print look with subtle paper grain, palette of coral red, cobalt, cream and sea green, strong geometric composition and negative space. One small readable heading SOLA at the top, no logos, no real place names, vertical 2:3 poster.
